endpoint_definition: Reduce token→basephone equal→class in each utterance/method/seed/lag; average 3 seeds within utterance/class; reduce utterances within speaker/class; apply high-low or low-high contrast after class reduction. Per utterance p is the integer median of 3 RMS full official offsets, borrowed by head; Hp is computed per utterance and class before speaker reduction.
lag_definition: At original core time j/25, read geometry at j+lag; positive lag reads later video; no clock modification.
normalization: Reused attempt03 row_standardization mean/population_sd by model/attribute/sample/method/seed; no lag-specific renormalization.
